usage: The word 慢啲 is used to tell someone to do something more slowly.
It usually appears before verbs to modify the speed of an action.
You can use 慢啲 when asking for caution or carefulness in movement or speech.
It is a casual and friendly way to advise someone to reduce their pace.
This word can be used in both spoken and informal written Cantonese.

examples.jyutping: nei5 hoi1 ce1 maan6 di1 aa3
gong2 maan6 di1, ngo5 teng1 m4 cing1 co2
examples.meaning: Speak slower, I can't hear clearly.

examples.jyutping: jam2 caa4 maan6 di1, m4 hou2 ngaak1 can1
haang4 lou6 maan6 di1, gaai1 hou2 waat6
examples.meaning: Walk slower, the street is slippery.
